serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Oh no… It’s him again.
You: Oh, hi Mr Landlord. What brings you here today? Not my rent payment, right?
Landlord: No, that’s not it. {{wi}}This time.
…
Landlord: The other time, when we ran at each other in the corridor. You said you were going for a walk, correct?
You: Y-yeah. What is this all about?
Landlord: Nothing really! Just, y’know, old me being curious, that’s all!
You: Right.
This guy is up to something. He acts too friendly.
Landlord: Do you remember seeing a young girl when coming back?
Did he see {f_botName}? It’s possible, there are windows facing the entry on the staircase after all. 
Even if he saw her, it shouldn't be a big deal, right? He has no reason to suspect her of being a sexbot.
He probably isn’t bluffing though. He wouldn’t bother coming here only because of a hunch.{{wi}} I think.
Landlord: So, what’s your answer, friend? Don’t leave me hanging! Hehe~
Friend…{{wi}} He definitely has some ulterior motive.
For now I should act like I have nothing to hide.
You: Yeah, I saw a girl. What about it?
Landlord: Woah, big guy! There is no need to be so defensive about it!
…
Landlord: I’m just asking because I found it very uncharacteristic of you to come home with a girl.
I never said that this girl was with me so he must have seen us. Why though he’s gotta be such a dick about it?!
You: Yeah, my friend came over for a while. 
Landlord: Well, that’s surprising.
